entry.title: DeepFire receives a Special Recognition at XPRIZE Wildfire

link.title: DeepFire receives a Special Recognition at XPRIZE Wildfire

entry.content:
The LSU DeepFire team received the $100,000 Special Recognition for Operational Deliverable in the Wildfire XPRIZE, Space-Based Wildfire Detection and Intelligence Track. DeepFire was one of five awarded teams in the track, among more than 300 teams worldwide. XPRIZE described the recognition as being for “an operational fire-spread-alert capability designed to support wildfire detection and intelligence.”

DeepFire links models for fire-risk prediction, early fire detection, and fire spread forecasting. My contributions are machine learning models that integrate meteorological data, satellite imagery, smoke detection, and spatio-temporal fire spread modeling, and data fusion pipelines that combine predictive risk maps with real-time environmental signals.

entry.title: DPEB: open multimodal embeddings for 22,043 human proteins

link.title: DPEB: open multimodal embeddings for 22,043 human proteins

entry.content:
The DeepDrug Protein Embeddings Bank (DPEB) paper was accepted in NAR Genomics and Bioinformatics in March 2026 (doi:10.1093/nargab/lqag042), and version 1.0.1 of the code is archived on Zenodo.

What is in it

DPEB provides embeddings for 22,043 human proteins from four pretrained models:

  • AlphaFold2 structural single representations (extracted in single-sequence mode),
  • ESM-2 (650M parameters, 1280-dimensional),
  • BioEmbeddings (ProtTrans BERT-BFD), and
  • ProtVec (300-dimensional).

AlphaFold2 structures are public, but the network’s internal embeddings are not, and DPEB fills that gap.

What we benchmarked

We combined interactions from HPRD, HuMAP, IntAct, and STRING into a confidence-weighted graph of more than 11 million interaction pairs and compared GraphSAGE, GCN, GAT, GTN, and GIN for protein-protein interaction link prediction. GraphSAGE with BioEmbeddings gave the best result: 87.37% AUROC and 79.16% accuracy.

Where to get it

  • Data: AWS Open Data Registry (CC-BY 4.0)
  • Code: github.com/deepdrugai/DPEB (MIT license)
